description: This file defines the PerformanceReviewSaveController class, which manages the rendering of the performance review form (either for editing or adding a review) in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up the Vue component with appropriate properties based on the request attributes.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewSaveController
classes.description: Controller responsible for rendering the performance review form, either for creating a new review or editing an existing one, based on the provided request attribute 'id'.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component for rendering by determining whether to load an 'edit-review' or 'add-review' component based on the presence of an 'id' attribute in the request. Sets the component with the appropriate properties.
